text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So many people wearing dresses...! 
So this is the Lolita Festival!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely event.
Kris, thank you for coming along with me♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――No problem.
I also――have something I want to verify.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, is that so!
Then let us both have a great time♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...Fine can
read――my thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Is she psychic?
Or... is there some――secret?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Mission, executing.
I will uncover――the truth.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the photo booth pictures arrived!
Our eyes look so wide and bright!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Japanese technology is quite inter――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Fine, get behind me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――A crowd... gathered suddenly.
Danger――something... is happening.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My... fufu♪ It's alright, Kris.
I'm sure we're about to witness something wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Unbelievable.
To think it was... a flash mob.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That was such a wonderful proposal~!
We were quite fortunate to see it♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah――but how.
How did you know――it was a flash mob?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just as you felt, Kris, everyone seemed quite tense.
Touching their hair, crossing their arms again. However――

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's feet were pointed towards that couple.
Which means their attention was focused entirely on those two.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The man in the couple noticed the attention too.
Yet... far from being suspicious, he was simply caressing the engagement ring on his left hand.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's when I realized.
Ah, these people must be his accomplices, and he is about to do something of a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: When people are nervous, their awareness tends to drift towards the root of their tension♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...
So that's, why.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
You were――observing.
My... thoughts――from my movements.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! ...Fufu, you figured it out!
Yes――it's "nonverbal communication", you see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Reading a person's true feelings through body orientation and hand gestures.
I often attended social gatherings, so perhaps I picked it up naturally?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Though with you, Kris, it isn't just that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Because you and I are "alike".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Alike?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Look! We are both international students, close in age, and our grades are almost identical!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And we even ordered the exact same menu items♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
That is――indeed true.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...?
...Why are you... looking at me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
I was just thinking how cute you are, Kris♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
You're so expressive, and ve~ry cute!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Especially your eyes, they're quite the chatterbox, so I couldn't help but gaze at you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Is that so――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Maybe――this is what it means.
My chest is... "sowa-sowa" fluttering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking downtown one day, I spotted Fine Motion and Kris dressed in unusual attire and called out to them.
choice_data_list: You two get along so well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking downtown one day, I spotted Fine Motion and Kris dressed in unusual attire and called out to them.
choice_data_list: You two get along so well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you! It makes me happy if it looks that way to you♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing how well they got along brought a warm feeling of happiness to me as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No... it's the Lolita Festival.
Not particularly――a celebration.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but that's a wonderful idea!
Let's celebrate, Kris!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: To commemorate discovering how similar we are♪
